senses.gloss: नाभि- + गुप्त नाभि- + गुप्त, the name of a division of the world, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 15.

नभ् नभ्, i. 1, Ātm. † i. 4, ii. 9, Par.
 1. To burst.
 2. To injure.
नभ नभ, m. A proper name, Hariv. 823.

नाभ नाभ,
 I. a substitute for नाभि, when latter part of a comp. adj. or of a noun based on an adj., e. g. अब्ज- and पद्म- (Having a lotus in his navel), m. A name of Viṣṇu. पद्म-नाभ also,
 1. A proper name.
 2. A kind of spell. सु-, adj.
 1. Having a handsome nave, MBh. 10, 625.
 2. Having a beautiful centre, Rām. 1, 33, 12. काल-, m. The name of an Asura or demon and others. कुश-, m. A proper name, Rām. 1, 34, 3. त्रि-, m. A name of Viṣṇu (holding the three worlds in his navel), Bhāg. P. 8, 17, 26. दृध-, m. The name of a spell, Rām. 1, 30, 5. पुष्कर-, m. A name of Viṣṇu, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 48. वत्स-, m. a particular poisonous tree.
 II. m. Epithet of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10364.
 III. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 16.
नभग नभग, m. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 8, 13, 2.
नाभाग नाभाग (cf. नभग), m. A proper name. MBh. 1, 3140; Rām. 1, 70, 41.
नभःश्रित् नभःश्रित्, i. e. नभस्-श्रि + त्, adj. Reaching to, or attaining heaven.

नभश्चर नभश्चर, i. e. नभस्-चर,
 I. adj. Moving in the sky, Rām. 3, 49, 45.
 II. m. A deity, Ragh. 18, 5.

नभस् नभस्, n.
 1. Sky, atmosphere, Man. 4, 37.
 2. du. Heaven and earth, MBh. 12, 13240.
 3. Æther as one of the five elements, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 12.
 4. (n. and m.) The name of a month of the rainy season (July--August), Ragh. 12, 29.
 --Cf. νέϕος, δνόϕος, ἰο-δνεϕής, γνόϕος, νεϕέλη; Lat. nubes, nebula; O.H.G. nibul; A.S. ge-nip, a cloud.
नभस्य नभस् + य, m. The name of a month of the rainy season, Hariv. 8781.

नभस्वन्त् नभस् + वन्त्,
 1. m. Wind, Ṛt. 2, 27.
 2. f. वती, A proper name, Bhāg. P. 4, 24, 5.
नाभागि नाभागि, i. e. नाभाग + इ, patronym. A son of Nābhāga, MBh. 12, 993.

नाभि नाभि (नभ् + इ ?), f. (also नाभी नाभी), and m.
 1. The navel, Man. 1, 92.
 2. The nave of a wheel, MBh. 1, 726.
 3. Centre, Bhāg. P. 5, 16, 7.
 4. Chief, Ragh. 18, 19.
 5. Musk, Megh. 53.
 6. (m. ?) The musk animal, Bhāg. P. 3, 21, 44.
 7. m. A proper name, 5, 2, 19.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. A.S. nafu, nafela; ὀμϕαλός; Lat. umbilicus.
नाभिक नाभि + क, a substitute for नाभि at the end of comp. adj., MBh. 12, 8946.

नाभ्य नाभ्य, i. e. नाभि + य, adj.
 1. Proceeding from the navel, Bhāg. P. 3, 4, 13.
 3. Epithet of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10364.
 --Comp.
नाभि-नाला नाभि-नाला, f. the navelstring, Ragh. 5, 7.
नाभि- + वर्धन नाभि- + वर्धन, n. the section of the navelstring, Man. 2, 29.
नभोवीथी नभोवीथी, i. e. नभस्-, f. the orbit of the sun, Bhāg. P. 5, 22, 6.
नभस्- + सरस् नभस्- + सरस्, n. clouds, sky, Rām. 5, 55, 4.
नभस्- + स्पृश नभस्- + स्पृश, adj. touching the heavens, Bhag. 11, 24 (may belong also to नभः-स्पृश्).
